sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday. The leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of WIN-DRAW-WIN-WIN-WIN, and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches. This represents a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their commanding position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture that offers the visitors a chance to consolidate their position; Stafford have earned 20 points and sit just two behind the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two competitive sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community in a battle between nearby rivals where both have recent wins in their form. Bilston Town (5th, 17 pts) host Foley Meir (13th, 11 pts) in a fixture favoring the home side's quality. In lower-division action, Shawbury United entertain Barnton, with Shawbury seeking to end a difficult recent run; Crewe host Allscott Heath in a relegation-zone contest; Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills looking to arrest their own inconsistent form; Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-area clash; and Brereton Social host Widnes Town, who remain winless this season with just 2 points from 7 games.
